things that will make you
dangerously well read

a book in every bag

keep a paperback in every bag you own. the ten minutes waiting for a bus or a friend add up to dozens of books a year that you'd never have found time for.

classics in audio

listen to the classics while you walk or commute. a great narrator makes old books come alive, and suddenly war and peace feels like a long, gripping story.

one non fiction a month

alternate novels with one non fiction book a month: history, science, biography. stories teach you people, and facts teach you the world they live in.

the story behind it

spend 5 minutes a day learning the story behind a famous book, author or idea. knowing the context makes every page you read deeper and far easier to remember.
slides.texte_sophia:
the story behind it

spend 5 minutes a day learning the story behind a famous book or author. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and every page you read gets deeper.

slides.texte_overlay:
writing in the margins

write one thought in the margin of every chapter you read. reading with a pencil turns you from a passenger into someone actually talking with the author.
